#define BITS(N) \ /* <=== libclamav/wwunpack.c:53:72:BITS:1 */ 
bits = bt>>(32-(N)); \

  bc -= (N); \
  bt<<=(N); \
  if (!bc) { \
    RESEED; \
  } \
} else { \
  if (CLI_ISCONTAINED(compd, szd, ccur, 4)) { \
    bt = cli_readint32(ccur); \
    ccur+=4; \
    bc += 32 - (N); \
    bits |= bt>>(bc); \
